notes: YOK-26 first pass, every number proposed for the Sparring Partner to tune. A newcomer on Kihon (K2): sees the screen 24 ticks late (P6: only on-screen state, never the opponent's buttons), decides every 8 ticks, presses a random normal whatever the range on 15% of its decisions (mistake), puts its guard up (standing only) for 50% of the threats it sees (a swing or a projectile, rolled once each, held while the threat lasts) and anti-airs 15% of jumps with heavy punch. Specials are Special + direction (neutral A, forward B, back C, down D). Route: the dojo when one is reachable (R4's newcomer heal@4 + rest@7 line), else a seeded random pick. Rewards: an upgrade first, then a new special, then a modifier; a card with several targets goes on the lowest slot. Merchant: the free heal; dojo: rest. A fight with no KO after max_fight_ticks counts as a loss (no round timer is written in rules.md). menu_seconds_per_node is the time outside fights per node for the run-length estimate (R9). Merchant plans: heal, shop (buy shelf commons through the shop, YOK-95, never release), heal_if_hurt_else_shop (with heal_below_pct), skip; the default heals (R4). PROVISIONAL until the designer rules (YOK-36, decision log 'YOK-26 harness'): max_fight_ticks 10800 (3-minute fight cap), menu_seconds_per_node 45, and per-run AI and bot seeds derived from the run seed (batch seeds base..base+n-1, base 1).
